assets.title: Hazard-control decision flow
assets.purpose: Show the decision sequence from routine control through authorized isolation/stop-work and escalation.

assets.title: PPE and HazCom decision map
assets.purpose: Connect task, hazard assessment, label/SDS information, site procedure, restrictions, and PPE decisions.

assets.title: Cultivation work-area hazard scan
assets.purpose: Practice scanning a cultivation work area for representative physical, electrical, access, and exposure concerns.

assets.title: Biosecurity pathway map
assets.purpose: Show how people, tools, carts, hoses, plants, and debris can create contamination pathways across controlled transitions.

assets.title: Cleaning and disinfection sequence
assets.purpose: Teach the ordered distinction between material control, debris removal, cleaning, product verification, application/contact conditions, finish steps, inspection, and documentation.

assets.title: Quarantine, hold, and restricted-entry comparison
assets.purpose: Keep plant-health isolation, operational material status, and pesticide worker-entry controls conceptually separate.

assets.title: Controlled-document anatomy
assets.purpose: Show the fields a technician must read in a controlled SOP or work order before acting.

assets.title: Material genealogy
assets.purpose: Visualize how controlled identity and genealogy persist through propagation, movement, harvest, sampling, and disposition.

assets.title: Inventory reconciliation flow
assets.purpose: Show how physical and recorded counts are compared, verified, preserved when discrepant, and escalated without forced balancing.

assets.title: Operator-care versus servicing boundary
assets.purpose: Separate assigned operator cleaning/checks from disassembly, protected access, jam clearing, and hazardous-energy servicing, and reinforce authorization boundaries.

assets.title: Maintenance-ready fault report
assets.purpose: Teach the difference between observations, permitted checks, results, operational impact, and unsupported root-cause claims.

assets.title: Professional shift-handoff model
assets.purpose: Show outgoing preparation, written status, two-way exchange, incoming cross-check, and ownership of open conditions.

assets.title: Deviation and incomplete-work status decision map
assets.purpose: Help learners classify complete work, planned exceptions, deviations, incomplete work, and unknown or unverified status without manufacturing completion.

assets.title: Data-integrity record lifecycle
assets.purpose: Show the lifecycle from controlled identity and contemporaneous observation through attributable entry, transparent correction, late or missing-data handling, and reconstructable handoff.
